evidence.rc27UserDevice: The mini scanner recognized the pairing QR and returned the fallback notice; it did not open WeChat authorization. This is not evidence of a completed binding.
evidence.retiredExperiments: RC26 web-view handoff was removed in RC27. RC28 removes the failed mini scanCode pairing action, its callbacks, transient state, fallback modal and obsolete tests.
evidence.officialConfirmation: Only the user's explicit confirmation in WeChat may replace an existing provider binding. Neither a decoded QR, opened image, copied link nor page return is a successful authorization receipt.

flow: Enable the optional mini ClawBot remote-control entrance, then connect to the intended node.
Open that node's WeChat Connection plugin page on the computer. The mini button requests the pairing code; it does not remotely navigate the desktop UI.
Use WeChat homepage + / Scan to scan the computer code and confirm in WeChat.
The plugin independently reads this attempt's result within a bounded local five-minute lifetime. Returning to the mini reads the actual node state.
Select an existing session and explicitly enable receiving. Pairing success never enables receiving or changes the target automatically.

controlHierarchy.phoneEntrance: Local opt-in only: entrance, session marker and route menu. Hiding it or leaving the page does not stop the node or cancel a pairing attempt.
controlHierarchy.nativeComponent: The DSH native plugin manager owns component mounting. If unavailable, the mini gives a clear instruction rather than pretending to enable it.
controlHierarchy.receiving: One node-owned receive state, reflected by the same switch on desktop and mini. Enabling requires a valid binding, a target and no active pairing.
controlHierarchy.sourceOfTruth: Plugin storage/runtime and provider receipts. Clients fence requests and responses by node, connection epoch, request ownership and revision.
controlHierarchy.nativeHost: No native presets, model/default settings, global tool sets, unrelated plugins, child agents or host services are changed.

ui.mini: Pairing first, target and receive control below. One contextual main action. No inline QR or scanner/browser button. QR preview and copied link remain in Other ways; re-pair/removal are under Manage.
ui.desktop: Compact node-labelled sections, round mark, QR beside concise instructions, accessible rounded receive switch, light/dark and narrow layouts. Routine duplicate instructions are hidden; unknown and safety messages remain visible.
ui.synchronization: Desktop status reads every four seconds while mounted; mini status reads every five seconds while visible, with bounded compatible provider reads during pairing. Neither UI needs to stay open for the new plugin to collect confirmation.
ui.recovery: Expiry, cancellation, verification-code entry, failed replacement and re-pairing preserve explicit user decisions. Re-pair/removal first pause receiving through a revision-fenced chain and never silently resume.

runtime.ownership: The plugin starts one bounded watcher only after a requested QR was generated. UI polling and watcher reads share the existing single-flight lane.
runtime.retry: Only read-only transient status requests retry at bounded 1/2/4/8/15-second scheduling; no automatic login start, verification-code replay, message replay or binding replacement.
runtime.cleanup: Cancellation, expiry, confirmation and component disposal clear timers/provider attempt state and abort obsolete reads. Verification-code waits suspend automatic reads.
runtime.storageFailure: A failed background persistence operation fails closed, preserves the old data and retains an explicit restart-required notice. Restored disk availability does not reopen the instance. Pending route commands, native task results and multi-part sends cannot continue after the closed-state fence; native DSH tasks are not cancelled and already-sent fragments are not replayed.

verification.independentReview: Original storage-recovery, in-flight slash-route and multi-part-send reproductions pass after fixes. Runtime and panel tests 69/69; no remaining blocker within reviewed scope.
verification.pluginExistingSuite: npm test exit 0; environment-specific skips remain skips, not acceptance evidence.
verification.nativeBoundary: Installed DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 code used in a disposable isolated profile: actual mini control client, strict native codec/gateway, component mount/dispose/remount and native registry/default/four-mode preservation. No real profile, credentials, chat, network or model calls.
verification.compile: TypeScript host/client bundle and native WeChat wcc/wcsc compilation passed.
verification.visual: 64 source-derived mini layouts and 28 actual React/CSS isolated desktop scenarios, light/dark and narrow/wide, passed geometry/accessibility checks. Representative images visually inspected; not real-device rendering.
verification.packaging: Actual core tarball: 316 modules, 25 host imports and 88 native schema checks. Dual-entry installer: 326 identical core files, native exports, bundled dependencies, CLI help and bounded recovery passed. 8/8 package-closure regression tests passed.

artifacts.compatibilityMetadata: Built with --unverified: this candidate inherits no previous release's real-device acceptance matrix.

releaseBoundary.realPairingAndMessageRoundTrip: Still pending user/device acceptance; no claim of completed pairing or text delivery.
